headword: アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}
gloss: allergic constitution; a tendency to have allergic reactions

definitions.gloss: allergic constitution; a tendency to have allergic reactions
definitions.explanation: A physical constitution or predisposition that makes a person prone to allergic reactions. Often used to describe people who react easily to pollen, foods, or other allergens.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}はアレルギー{体質|たいしつ}だ。
アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}の{子|こ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of children with allergic tendencies is increasing.

examples.japanese: アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}のため、{新|あたら}しい{化粧品|けしょうひん}を{使|つか}う{前|まえ}には{必|かなら}ずパッチテストをする。
examples.english: Because I have an allergic constitution, I always do a patch test before using new cosmetics.

notes:
Composed of アレルギー (allergy, from German "Allergie") and {体質|たいしつ} (physical constitution, bodily makeup). {体質|たいしつ} in Japanese refers to an inherited or long-term physical tendency of the body, not a temporary condition. Saying someone is アレルギー{体質|たいしつ} describes them as generally prone to allergies rather than having one specific allergy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}だ: to have an allergic constitution
- アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}の{人|ひと}/{子|こ}: a person/child with an allergic constitution
- アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}の{方|かた}はご{注意|ちゅうい}ください: customers with allergies should take care (common label/announcement phrase)
- アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve one's allergic constitution

RELATED TERMS:
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}: hay fever, pollen allergy
- {食物|しょくもつ}アレルギー: food allergy
- アトピー{性皮膚炎|せいひふえん}: atopic dermatitis
- {体質|たいしつ}: constitution (general term for {太|ふと}りやすい{体質|たいしつ} "a body type that gains weight easily," etc.)
- {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}: sensitive skin
